name: DripBeaks
summary: Get ready for an exciting archery challenge with a unique extended reality experience. The bow appears in your hands, and you’ll aim at flying birds around you. Each bird you hit adds to your score, but if you shoot the red bird three times, it’s game over! You’ve got just 5 minutes on the clock to rack up as many points as you can—a fun game that’s perfect for a quick break or to challenge yourself. Plus, you can play anywhere, no internet needed.
